renderer.note: Uses the native 1080x1920 portrait composition. The renderer assembles local video clips, title cards, soundtrack, music and captions; it does not generate source footage.

safe_area.rule: Keep faces, essential action, titles and subtitles inside the central portrait-safe region; leave additional bottom space for platform UI.

palette.golden_age: warm gold, ivory stone, living greens
palette.present_ruins: weathered stone, cold blue-grey, muted earth

continuity: Auren is primarily a swordsman; magic enhances and follows his sword technique.
Keep the ancient kingdom's architecture, royal emblem and banners consistent across all shots.
Keep the identity of the enemy and the full bloodline history unrevealed in the opening.
vertical_framing: Compose natively for 9:16 portrait; do not plan widescreen shots for center-cropping.
Keep the primary subject near the vertical center and preserve headroom and footroom.
For kingdoms and battlefields, use layered foreground-to-background depth and vertical camera movement to communicate scale.
For sword combat, keep both fighters and blade paths inside the portrait frame; favor medium and close coverage over extremely wide lateral choreography.
Place subtitles and titles within the safe area, away from the top and bottom platform interface zones.

narration.text: Every kingdom believes its walls will outlive its enemies. Every king believes his name will outlive his grave.
But kingdoms do not fall when their walls are broken. They fall when the people forget what they were built to protect.
